title: My Health Buddy — Copy updates for Safety, Privacy, Menu, and Confirmation screens

requirements.summary: Add emergency guidance paragraph block and age-range line to the Safety Notice page.
acceptanceCriteria: On frontend/src/pages/SafetyNoticePage.tsx, the Emergency Guidance section includes the three new sentences exactly as provided (including 112/911).
On frontend/src/pages/SafetyNoticePage.tsx, the page includes the exact line: “Designed for children ages 4–12 with adult supervision.”
All new user-facing text on the Safety Notice page is in English.

file_operations.description: Update rendered copy on the Safety Notice page: (1) in the “Emergency Guidance” section, add a new paragraph block containing exactly these three sentences (with the same wording and numbers): "If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number" then "In many countries this is 112 or 911." then "Ask a grown-up to help you call."; and (2) add the exact age-range line: “Designed for children ages 4–12 with adult supervision.”

requirements.summary: Add the offline/no-sending statement to the Privacy & Safety page.
acceptanceCriteria: On frontend/src/pages/grownups/PrivacySafetyPage.tsx, the exact sentence “The app works fully offline and does not send information anywhere.” appears in the rendered content.
The sentence is visible in normal page flow (not hidden behind an interaction).

file_operations.description: Insert the exact sentence “The app works fully offline and does not send information anywhere.” into the normal, always-visible content flow of the Privacy & Safety page (e.g., within an existing card body near the privacy/offline explanation).

requirements.summary: Change the Menu screen disclaimer to display only “Not medical advice.” without affecting other screens’ disclaimers.
acceptanceCriteria: When viewing the Menu screen (frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx), the bottom disclaimer displayed via ScreenLayout is exactly “Not medical advice.”
This change does not unintentionally remove or alter disclaimers on other screens unless they are also part of the Menu screen UI.

file_operations.description: Add an optional prop (e.g., disclaimerText) that allows a caller to override the default disclaimer copy when showDisclaimer is true; keep the existing default disclaimer text unchanged for screens that do not pass the override.
Update MenuPage to pass a disclaimer override to ScreenLayout so the rendered bottom disclaimer on the Menu screen is exactly “Not medical advice.” (and only the Menu screen changes).

requirements.summary: Update the grown-ups entry label on the Menu screen to “Parents, Teachers & Caregivers Only”.
acceptanceCriteria: On frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx, the grown-ups access button label text is exactly “Parents, Teachers & Caregivers Only”.
The label is visible without needing to navigate away from the Menu screen.

file_operations.description: Replace the grown-ups access button label text so it renders exactly: “Parents, Teachers & Caregivers Only” on the Menu screen.

requirements.summary: Update Feeling Confirmation screen help/call-to-action copy to “Show this to a trusted adult”.
acceptanceCriteria: On the screen where the child is prompted to show their selected feeling to an adult (frontend/src/pages/FeelingConfirmationPage.tsx), the help message shown to the child uses the exact text: “Show this to a trusted adult”.
Any existing call-to-action text on that screen that currently says “Show this to an adult” is updated to match “Show this to a trusted adult”, so the UI is consistent.

file_operations.description: Update FeelingConfirmationPage copy so both the helper message (passed to ScreenLayout) and the primary call-to-action button text use the exact text: “Show this to a trusted adult” (replacing any existing “Show this to an adult” wording for consistency).
